title: Pirate's Treasure
start: Speak to Redbeard Frank just south of The Rusty Anchor pub in Port Sarim.

items.t: White apron (an apron spawns on the wall of Gerrant's shop, in Port Sarim)
60 coins, or a ring of charos (a) and 30 coins

rewards.t: A casket containing 450 coins, an emerald and a gold ring
Ability to work as a menial labourer on a banana plantation (30 coins for each export crate the player fills with 10 bananas)

steps.t: Talk to Redbeard Frank just outside Port Sarim's pub. [Chat: 1 I'm in search of treasure. › Accept]
Walk south along the docks, pay 30 coins to Captain Tobias to go to Karamja. [Chat: 1 Yes please.]
Head inside the pub.
Buy one Karamjan rum from Zembo.
Do not leave the island yet or more rum will have to be obtained.
Pick 10 bananas from the Banana Trees to the north-west.
Go east to the house by the docks.
Talk to Luthas about the officer. [Chat: 2 That customs officer is annoying isn't she?], then talk to him a second time to ask for a job. [Chat: 1 Could you offer me employment on your plantation?]
On the east side of Luthas' house will be a wooden crate.
Use the Karamjan rum on the crate, then right-click Fill the crate.
Talk to Luthas.
Head to Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim.
Equip your white apron and attempt to open the door to the back room. [Chat: 1 Well, can I get a job here?]

sub.t: A free white apron can be obtained from the back wall in the fishing store.

steps.t: Search the crate with the banana on it.
With the rum, return to Redbeard Frank for a chest key. [Chat: 1 Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.]
Go upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in south Varrock.
Open the chest in the south-west room for a pirate message. Read it.
Go to Falador Park and stand on the east end of the pond, directly west of the statue of Saradomin, indicated by X on the ground.
Right-click Dig using the pirate message. Kill the gardener. Alternatively, leave the site for a while and the gardener will be gone.
Right-click Dig using the message again.
Quest complete!
